scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, or Jains)
Applicant must have secured admission to a professional or technical course approved by an agency such as AICTE, Medical Council of India, UGC, etc., in a recognized institute
Applicant must have obtained at least 50% marks in the qualifying examination for the course
Annual family income must not exceed ₹98,000 for rural residents or ₹1,20,000 for urban residents
Applicant must possess a Parivaar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID)
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to ₹20 lakh for studies in India and up to ₹30 lakh for studies abroad at a 3% interest rate to eligible minority community students.
